components.description: Free annotation with optional leader hint; anchored anywhere.
Area chart (cumulative composition).
Category bar chart (class areas, counts).
Class-area bar chart bound to classification statistics (hectares or percent).
Confusion/change matrix rendered as a labeled grid; diagonal emphasized.
Grouped bar chart: side-by-side series per label with a compact series legend (real multi-series rendering).
Histogram of values (band statistics, index distribution).
Line chart (profiles, trends).
Compact metric card (OA, Kappa, F1) with big value + label, for accuracy strips.

compatibility.note: use only when shares of a whole are the message

components.description: Share-of-total chart.
Scatter plot (feature relationships).
Axes-free compact trend line with a dashed baseline; the series-extraction companion for report blocks.
Summary table with an n/mean and sum/min-max header block above the rows.
Two-column label/value table (class areas, counts, metrics); deterministic 64-row cap with an overflow row.
Time-anchored line chart with date labels (phenology, NDVI trajectory, water level).
Top-N table: rows sorted by value descending, capped at style.top_n (default 10) with a rank column.
Asymmetric diverging strip where the neutral point is off-center (declared min/mid/max).
Discrete class strip for qualitative rasters; uses an explicit color stop list.
Diverging ramp centered on a neutral midpoint (anomalies, change magnitude, NDVI anomalies).
Log-scaled strip for skewed variables (backscatter proxies, density); label ticks are decades.
Probability/confidence strip fixed to [0,1] with percent labels.
SAR backscatter strip in dB with negative-value ticks (typically -25…0 dB).
Sequential gradient strip with min/max labels; ramp resolves through the token palette table.
Map frame border style applied to the primary map frame.
Latitude/longitude graticule over the map frame.
Metric coordinate grid (meters) for projected frames (UTM/Gauss-Krüger sheets).
Overview locator: small-frame extent outline of the main map's coverage.
Class-based legend for categorical rasters and vectors.
From→To transition legend for change products (paired rows colored by transition class).
Gradient legend body for continuous rasters (paired with a colorbar).
Legend with grouped headings (e.g. land cover groups, scenario groups).
Fixed raster class legend (class id, label, color) that does not depend on the live renderer.
Uncertainty/hatching legend for probability or confidence products; uses the token uncertainty palette.
Paired before/after frames declared with equal size and aligned tops for change products.
Primary map frame with declared extent, scale, rotation, and layer set.
N synchronized small-multiple frames (temporal steps, scenarios) declared with a count and grid.
Simple grid-north arrow for clean thematic layouts.
Operational/navigation north arrow for mission sheets and quick looks.
Publication-grade true-north arrow.
Figure label ('图1', 'Figure 2') in the token figure_label style.
Institution logo placeholder box; swap the picture path at composition time.
Photo/panel image frame for report pages (scene thumbnail, field photo).
Metric scale bar paired with a secondary unit label line (km + miles) for international reports.
Scale bar for projected maps; style variants map to QGIS scale bar renderers.
Data source and processing provenance note (token style 'source_note').
Secondary line under the main title: product, region, or date context.
Legal or interpretation disclaimer rendered in the secondary text color.
Multi-line metadata block (sensor, date, CRS, processing level) for the map margin.
Figure caption with number, e.g. 'Fig. 1 — Land cover 2024'. Styled from token 'caption'.
Short section label ('A', 'Study area', '方法') introducing a map panel or figure group.
Two-line bilingual title (CJK primary line, Latin secondary line) rendered as one label block.
Primary map title. Token style 'title' (20pt bold by default); one per page.

styles.description: AOI/region boundary overlay: dashed accent line with optional label.
Bare Soil Index continuous ramp (vegetated to exposed soil).
dNBR burn severity: unburned to high-severity, USGS-inspired class breaks.
Discrete change map: loss, stable, gain with colorblind-safe diverging colors.
DEM elevation with sequential ramp; pair with hillshade blend (blend knowledge for the map layer).
Flood event extent classes: normal channel, flooded, receding.
Flood probability 0-1 as a continuous uncertainty ramp.
Discrete land-cover classes bound to the land_cover token palette.
NDVI continuous ramp from bare/monitoring minimum to dense canopy.
NDWI continuous water-index ramp (negative land to positive water).
SAR backscatter in dB as a gray stretch with documented percentile bounds.
SAR log-ratio change: diverging ramp around 0 dB (loss/deposition).
Slope classes for terrain analysis (flat to very steep).
NDSI snow cover: snow, snow-free, cloud/QA.
Model confidence 0-1 on the uncertainty ramp; low confidence darkens.
Built-up density from bare to dense urban fabric.
Binary surface-water extent (0 dry, 1 water) with a token-linked water color and transparent dry class.

token_sets.description: Dark style for screen delivery (slide decks, dashboards, agent previews). Print export with this set is supported but documented as experimental: paper is reflective white, so dark pages waste toner and most journals reject them.
Default light scientific style for print-quality remote-sensing map products. Colorblind-safe qualitative palette (Okabe-Ito); ColorBrewer sequential/diverging ramps.
